fusions.name: Slammed Gate
fusions.desc: Swings your arms shut on everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage, stunning each enemy for 1 second and leaving it [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shrinking Cell
fusions.desc: Closes every arm around a weakened enemy and tightens for 22 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound and [Inescapable] for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: No Way Past
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: No Slipping Free
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% physical resistance.
